title: What may the assistant and its workers do without asking?
description: Choose a concrete autonomy policy for the first release. Recommendation: permit configured read-only lookups and bounded worker execution inside an explicitly authorized workspace, and surface consequential actions and unexpected permissions for approval. Avoid repeated prompts for the same still-valid scope. Never infer approval from silence or from a worker message.
